quests.instruction: Bus 1 leaves at 8:05 and arrives at 8:40. Bus 2 leaves at 8:20 and arrives at 9:05. Bus 3 leaves at 8:35 and arrives at 9:05. Which bus has the shortest journey?
quests.hint: Find the length of each journey. Do not just look at the arrival times.
quests.explanation: Bus 1 takes 35 minutes, Bus 2 takes 45 minutes and Bus 3 takes 30 minutes. So Bus 3 has the shortest journey.
quests.funFact: The famous Swiss railway clock has a red second hand that pauses for a moment at the top of every minute.

quests.instruction: Train P runs 2:10 to 2:55 PM, Train Q runs 2:30 to 3:10 PM and Train R runs 2:45 to 3:35 PM. Mira must arrive by 3:15 PM. Which trains get her there in time?
quests.hint: Check which trains arrive at 3:15 PM or earlier.
quests.explanation: Train P arrives at 2:55 PM and Train Q arrives at 3:10 PM, both before 3:15. Train R arrives at 3:35 PM, which is too late.
quests.funFact: Russia is so wide that it has 11 time zones.

quests.instruction: Ferry 1 runs 10:10 to 10:50, Ferry 2 runs 10:30 to 11:15 and Ferry 3 runs 10:50 to 11:30. Which two ferries take the same amount of time?
quests.hint: Work out each journey length first.
quests.explanation: Ferry 1 takes 40 minutes, Ferry 2 takes 45 minutes and Ferry 3 takes 40 minutes. So Ferries 1 and 3 take the same time.
quests.funFact: France has more time zones than any other country, because of its territories around the world.

quests.instruction: Ana arrived 15 minutes before Ben. Ben arrived 10 minutes before Cleo. Cleo arrived at 4:40 PM. When did Ana arrive?
quests.hint: Start with Cleo and work backwards one person at a time.
quests.explanation: Ben arrived 10 minutes before 4:40, at 4:30 PM. Ana arrived 15 minutes before that, at 4:15 PM.
quests.funFact: In medieval times, a "moment" was a real unit of time that lasted about 90 seconds.

quests.instruction: Pia finished after Raj but before Sam. Tom finished before Raj. Who finished last?
quests.hint: Put the runners in a line from first to last.
quests.explanation: Tom finished before Raj, Raj before Pia, and Pia before Sam. So Sam finished last.
quests.funFact: Big Ben is the name of the great bell inside the tower, not of the clock tower itself.

quests.instruction: A film starts 20 minutes after the adverts, which begin at 6:15 PM. The film lasts 1 hour 30 minutes. When does the film end?
quests.hint: First find when the film starts, then add its length.
quests.explanation: The adverts begin at 6:15, so the film starts at 6:35 PM. 1 hour 30 minutes later is 8:05 PM.
quests.funFact: The Apollo 11 spacecraft took about three days to travel from the Earth to the Moon.

quests.instruction: Leo leaves home at 8:10 and walks for 25 minutes. Maya leaves at 8:20 and cycles for 10 minutes. Who arrives first?
quests.hint: Work out each person's arrival time.
quests.explanation: Leo arrives at 8:35. Maya arrives at 8:30. So Maya arrives first, even though she left later.
quests.funFact: Cuckoo clocks come from the Black Forest region of Germany.

quests.instruction: Plan A: catch the 4:10 bus, with a 35-minute journey. Plan B: catch the 4:20 bus, with a 20-minute journey. Which plan arrives earlier, and by how much?
quests.hint: Find the arrival time for each plan.
quests.explanation: Plan A arrives at 4:45. Plan B arrives at 4:40. So Plan B arrives 5 minutes earlier.
quests.funFact: In 2019, a marathon runner ran 42 kilometres in just under two hours in a special unofficial event.

quests.instruction: Plan X gets you to the park at 3:40 PM. Plan Y gets you there at 4:05 PM. You must leave the park at 5:30 PM either way. Which plan gives more time at the park, and how much more?
quests.hint: Arriving earlier gives more time. Find the gap between the two arrival times.
quests.explanation: Plan X gives 1 hour 50 minutes at the park and Plan Y gives 1 hour 25 minutes. The difference is 25 minutes in favour of Plan X.
quests.funFact: The longest tennis match ever played lasted 11 hours and 5 minutes, spread over three days.

quests.instruction: Which event starts earliest: quarter to 5 PM, 4:35 PM or twenty past 4 PM?
quests.hint: Turn each time into digits first.
quests.explanation: Quarter to 5 is 4:45, twenty past 4 is 4:20, and the other is 4:35. The earliest is 4:20, which is twenty past 4.
quests.funFact: Many countries use the 24-hour clock every day, for example on train tickets.

quests.instruction: Which event finishes latest: half past 6 PM, 6:40 PM or quarter to 7 PM?
quests.hint: Turn each time into digits, then compare the minutes.
quests.explanation: Half past 6 is 6:30, the second event ends at 6:40, and quarter to 7 is 6:45. The latest is 6:45, which is quarter to 7.
quests.funFact: Wristwatches became popular in the early 1900s, when soldiers needed to read the time without taking out a pocket watch.

quests.instruction: Which time is the earliest in a day: 12:10 PM, 11:45 AM or 12:05 AM?
quests.hint: AM comes before PM. Think about when a new day begins.
quests.explanation: 12:05 AM is just after midnight, when the day begins. 11:45 AM is before noon and 12:10 PM is after noon, so 12:05 AM is the earliest.
quests.funFact: Cats sleep for 12 to 16 hours a day.

quests.instruction: Art runs 9:10 to 9:55. Music runs 10:05 to 10:40. PE runs 10:50 to 11:30. Which lesson is the shortest?
quests.hint: Work out the length of each lesson.
quests.explanation: Art takes 45 minutes, Music takes 35 minutes and PE takes 40 minutes. So Music is the shortest.
quests.funFact: Dolphins sleep with only half of their brain at a time.

quests.instruction: Which is the longest: A, 1 hour 5 minutes; B, 75 minutes; or C, 1 hour 10 minutes?
quests.hint: Change each length into minutes.
quests.explanation: A is 65 minutes, B is 75 minutes and C is 70 minutes. So B is the longest.
quests.funFact: Climbing Mount Everest takes about two months, including the time needed to rest and get used to the height.

quests.instruction: Which list is in order from shortest to longest?
quests.correctAnswer: Half an hour, three quarters of an hour, 50 minutes, 1 hour
options: Half an hour, three quarters of an hour, 50 minutes, 1 hour
Three quarters of an hour, half an hour, 50 minutes, 1 hour
Half an hour, 50 minutes, three quarters of an hour, 1 hour
quests.hint: Change every length into minutes.
quests.explanation: In minutes the lengths are 30, 45, 50 and 60. That is the order from shortest to longest.
quests.funFact: Lessons in Japanese schools usually last 45 to 50 minutes.

quests.instruction: Hari studied from 4:10 to 4:50 and again from 5:00 to 5:35. How long did he study altogether?
quests.hint: Find each study time separately, then add them.
quests.explanation: 4:10 to 4:50 is 40 minutes, and 5:00 to 5:35 is 35 minutes. 40 + 35 = 75 minutes, which is 1 hour 15 minutes.
quests.funFact: Taking short breaks while studying can help people remember more.

quests.instruction: Dina studied from 3:15 to 3:50, then from 4:00 to 4:25, then from 4:40 to 5:10. How long did she rest altogether between the sessions?
quests.hint: Find the gaps between the end of one session and the start of the next.
quests.explanation: The first rest is 3:50 to 4:00, which is 10 minutes. The second is 4:25 to 4:40, which is 15 minutes. 10 + 15 = 25 minutes.
quests.funFact: A cricket Test match can last up to five days.

quests.instruction: In a match, the first half runs from 3:00 to 3:40, the interval from 3:40 to 3:55, and the second half from 3:55 to 4:35. How long is the actual playing time?
quests.hint: Playing time does not include the interval.
quests.explanation: Each half lasts 40 minutes, and 40 + 40 = 80 minutes, which is 1 hour 20 minutes. The whole match including the interval lasts 1 hour 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: In many ball games the clock stops when play stops, so a match can last longer than its playing time.

quests.instruction: A film ends at 8:15 PM. What extra fact do you need to work out when it started?
quests.hint: To go back from an end time, you need a length of time.
quests.explanation: To find the start, you go back by the length of the film from 8:15 PM. Where it was made or who watched it does not change the times.
quests.funFact: Pilots file a flight plan with a departure time and an expected flight time.

quests.instruction: Mum knows a class ends at 4:30 PM. What extra fact is needed to work out how long the class lasts?
options: How many children are in it
quests.hint: A length of time lies between two times.
quests.explanation: A duration is the time between a start and an end. Knowing the end, you also need the start to find the length.
quests.funFact: Travel apps work out your arrival time by adding the journey length to your departure time.

quests.instruction: A walk starts at 10:20 AM and lasts 35 minutes. Which question can we answer from this?
quests.hint: Use only the times and the length that are given.
quests.explanation: The start time plus the length gives the end time, which is 10:55 AM. The distance and the number of people are not given.
quests.funFact: When information is missing, a good first step is to decide exactly what you still need to know.

quests.instruction: Timetable: Maths 9:00–9:50, English 10:00–10:40, Science 10:50–11:45, Art 11:55–12:30. Which lesson is the longest?
quests.hint: Find how long each lesson lasts, and then pick the biggest.
quests.explanation: Maths lasts 50 minutes, English 40, Science 55 and Art 35. So Science is the longest.
quests.funFact: School timetables are often drawn as a grid, with the days of the week across the top.

quests.instruction: Clubs: Chess 3:30–4:10, Drama 4:15–5:00, Choir 5:05–5:40, Gardening 5:45–6:15. How many clubs last less than 40 minutes?
quests.hint: Find each length. Remember that exactly 40 minutes is not less than 40 minutes.
quests.explanation: Chess lasts 40 minutes, Drama 45, Choir 35 and Gardening 30. Only Choir and Gardening are shorter than 40 minutes, so the answer is 2.
quests.funFact: Digital timetables on phones can update in real time when a bus or train is late.

quests.instruction: Library: Story time 10:00–10:25, Crafts 10:30–11:10, Quiz 11:20–11:45. How many minutes of gaps are there altogether?
quests.hint: Look at the time between the end of one activity and the start of the next.
quests.explanation: The first gap is 10:25 to 10:30, which is 5 minutes. The second gap is 11:10 to 11:20, which is 10 minutes. 5 + 10 = 15 minutes.
quests.funFact: Gaps between lessons or events are often kept to 5 or 10 minutes so that people can move to the next place.

quests.instruction: How many minutes are in 3 hours 35 minutes?
quests.hint: Change the 3 hours into minutes first.
quests.explanation: 3 hours is 180 minutes, and 180 + 35 = 215 minutes.
quests.funFact: Ancient Egyptians used a week with 10 days.

quests.instruction: A train ride is 215 minutes long. It starts at 9:35 AM. When does it end?
quests.hint: Change 215 minutes into hours and minutes first.
quests.explanation: 215 minutes is 3 hours 35 minutes. 9:35 AM plus 3 hours is 12:35 PM, and 35 more minutes makes 1:10 PM.
quests.funFact: In 1620, the ship called the Mayflower took 66 days to cross the Atlantic Ocean.

quests.instruction: Which is longer: 3 hours 40 minutes or 215 minutes?
quests.hint: Change both lengths into the same unit.
quests.explanation: 3 hours 40 minutes is 220 minutes, which is 5 minutes more than 215 minutes.
quests.funFact: A day on the Moon, from one sunrise to the next, lasts about 29 and a half Earth days.

quests.instruction: Bus 1 leaves at 3:10 and arrives at 3:55. Bus 2 leaves at 3:20 and arrives at 3:58. Bus 3 leaves at 3:30 and arrives at 4:00. Which statement is true?
quests.correctAnswer: Bus 1 arrives first, but Bus 3 has the shortest journey
options: Bus 1 arrives first, but Bus 3 has the shortest journey
Bus 3 arrives first and has the shortest journey
Bus 2 arrives first and has the shortest journey
quests.hint: Compare the arrival times, then work out the journey lengths.
quests.explanation: Bus 1 arrives at 3:55, the earliest time. The journeys take 45, 38 and 30 minutes, so Bus 3 has the shortest journey.
quests.funFact: British railways adopted Greenwich time in the 1840s so that every station showed the same time.

quests.instruction: Nia finished 10 minutes before Omar. Omar finished 25 minutes after Pia. Pia finished at 2:40 PM. When did Nia finish?
quests.hint: Find Omar's finishing time first.
quests.explanation: Omar finished 25 minutes after 2:40 PM, at 3:05 PM. Nia finished 10 minutes before that, at 2:55 PM.
quests.funFact: The word chronology comes from the Greek word chronos, which means time.

quests.instruction: A film is 1 hour 55 minutes long and begins at 6:50 PM. How much of the film is left at 8:10 PM?
quests.hint: Find how long the film has been playing first.
quests.explanation: From 6:50 PM to 8:10 PM is 1 hour 20 minutes. 1 hour 55 minutes minus 1 hour 20 minutes is 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: Film editors cut many hours of recorded footage down to a film of about two hours.
